contract: contract.json: Native iPhone progress uses existing MorningTheme, monthly rating first, seven recent daily scores next, and no history deletion.

accessibility.evidence: Inspected the 402-point Vietnamese accessibility-size captures: header, rating, points, all seven daily rows and weekly goal wrap without overlap. Daily accessibility elements expose a localized full date and score/no-record label; controls use native SwiftUI accessibility. No chart animation is added.

responsive.evidence: 402x874 default English and Vietnamese accessibility-size screenshots inspected. 390x844 direct launch also stalled in CoreSimulator; only SpringBoard rendered, so that capture was discarded.

loading.reason: Journal loading and scoring are synchronous; asynchronous StoreKit refresh does not replace locally rendered progress.

permission.reason: Viewing the local journal and scores requests no alarm, camera or microphone permission; existing paid access gating is preserved.

empty.evidence: Initial empty screen rendered in the interrupted run; final copy replaces 0/0 with an invitation to complete the first challenge. Final rendered check pending.

error.evidence: Read-error fixture and assertion are implemented, but XCTest runner launch failed before this check could run.

partial.evidence: Core tests verify recorded/unrecorded local dates and 0/50/100 scores. The final debug fixture includes an unrecorded day; rendered check pending.

success.evidence: Inspected the earlier 402x874 fixture: monthly 75/100 with 6/8 completions, clear rating and daily 0/50/100 scores. Final fixture has one less recorded success (71/100), with unchanged score layout.

Vietnamese accessibility sizes switch the seven bars to labeled daily rows; dates, scores and goal stay readable.
